sets.title: Which Case for Который?
sets.description: Choose the correct form of который for each relative clause
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильную форму «который» для каждого предложения

items.prompt: Это врач, _____ я звонил вчера. (This is the doctor whom I called yesterday.)
items.promptEnglish: This is the doctor whom I called yesterday.
items.explanation: Звонить takes dative: которому. Masculine singular dative of который.

items.prompt: Вот книга, _____ я тебе говорил. (Here's the book I told you about.)
items.promptEnglish: Here's the book I told you about.
items.hint: Говорить О чём? Prepositional case with о.
items.explanation: Говорить о + prepositional: о которой. Книга is feminine, prepositional = которой.

items.prompt: Человек, _____ я встретил на вечеринке, оказался писателем. (The person whom I met at the party turned out to be a writer.)
items.promptEnglish: The person I met at the party turned out to be a writer.
items.explanation: Встретить takes accusative. Animate masculine accusative = genitive form: которого.

items.prompt: Коллега, _____ я работаю, очень опытный. (The colleague with whom I work is very experienced.)
items.promptEnglish: The colleague with whom I work is very experienced.
items.hint: Работать С кем? Instrumental with с.
items.explanation: Работать с + instrumental: с которым. Masculine instrumental of который.

items.prompt: Девушка, _____ я дал цветы, моя сестра. (The girl to whom I gave flowers is my sister.)
items.promptEnglish: The girl to whom I gave flowers is my sister.
items.hint: Дать кому? Dative. Feminine dative = которой.
items.explanation: Дать takes dative: которой. Feminine singular dative of который.

items.prompt: Дом, _____ мы живём, построен в прошлом веке. (The house in which we live was built last century.)
items.promptEnglish: The house in which we live was built last century.
items.hint: Жить В чём? Prepositional with в (location).
items.explanation: Жить в + prepositional: в котором. Location = prepositional case.

items.prompt: Друзья, _____ я давно не видел, приехали в гости. (Friends whom I haven't seen for a long time came to visit.)
items.promptEnglish: Friends I haven't seen in a long time came to visit.
items.explanation: Видеть takes accusative. Animate plural accusative = genitive form: которых.

minimalPairs.context: Город, _____ я родился, очень красивый. (The city in which I was born is beautiful.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The city I was born in is very beautiful.
minimalPairs.explanation: Location (where I was born) = prepositional: в котором. Accusative (в который) would mean direction.

minimalPairs.context: Город, _____ мы едем, очень красивый. (The city we're going to is beautiful.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The city we're heading to is beautiful.
minimalPairs.explanation: Direction (where we're going) = accusative: в который. Prepositional (в котором) would mean location.

minimalPairs.context: Учитель, _____ мы уважаем, строгий, но справедливый. (The teacher we respect is strict but fair.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The teacher we respect is strict but fair.

minimalPairs.context: Учитель, _____ мы помогали, был очень благодарен. (The teacher we helped was very grateful.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The teacher we helped was very grateful.

sets.title: Cases and Prepositions
sets.description: Sort by case and fill in the correct form of который
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите падеж и заполните правильную форму «который»

categorySorting.instruction: Sort: Which case does который take in each sentence?

items.word: Фильм, ... я посмотрел (the film I watched)
Друг, ... я позвонил (the friend I called)
Ручка, ... я пишу (the pen I write with)
Студентка, ... я встретил (the student I met)
Врач, ... я доверяю (the doctor I trust)
Человек, ... я горжусь (the person I'm proud of)
Задача, ... я решил (the problem I solved)
Сосед, ... я помог (the neighbor I helped)
Нож, ... он резал хлеб (the knife he cut bread with)

blanks: Это ресторан, _____ мы часто ходим. (This is the restaurant we often go to.)
Вот женщина, _____ я купил цветы. (Here's the woman I bought flowers for.)
Парк, _____ мы гуляли вчера, очень большой. (The park where we walked yesterday is very big.)
Проблема, _____ мы столкнулись, была серьёзной. (The problem we faced was serious.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Preposition + который in the correct case
explanations: Direction (в + accusative): в который (masc. inanimate acc. = nominative form).

sets.title: Fix and Build
sets.description: Fix wrong forms of который and build complex sentences
sets.descriptionRussian: Исправьте неправильные формы «который» и постройте предложения

errorCorrection.sentence: Человек, которому я видел, был очень высоким.
errorCorrection.explanation: Видеть requires accusative. Animate masculine accusative = genitive: которого.

errorCorrection.sentence: Город, в который я живу, очень старый.
errorCorrection.hint: Жить В чём? Prepositional (location), not accusative (direction).
errorCorrection.explanation: Living IN a city = prepositional: в котором. В + accusative would mean direction.

errorCorrection.sentence: Подруга, которым я говорила по телефону, скоро приедет.
errorCorrection.hint: Говорить С кем? Instrumental with с. Подруга is feminine.
errorCorrection.explanation: Говорить с + instrumental. Feminine: с которой (not masculine которым).

errorCorrection.sentence: Проект, которого мы работаем, почти готов.
errorCorrection.hint: Работать НАД чем? Instrumental with над.
errorCorrection.explanation: Работать над + instrumental: над которым. The preposition is missing and the case is wrong.

translation.english: The woman who lives next door is a teacher.
translation.answer: Женщина, которая живёт по соседству, учительница.
translation.hint: Subject of the clause = nominative: которая (feminine). по соседству = next door

translation.english: The book I'm reading is very interesting.
translation.answer: Книга, которую я читаю, очень интересная.

translation.english: The city we're traveling to is on the coast.
translation.answer: Город, в который мы едем, находится на побережье.
acceptableVariants: Город, в который мы едем, стоит на побережье.
translation.hint: Direction: в + accusative. Город is masc. inanimate: в который

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All cases of который in varied contexts

items.prompt: Магазин, _____ я хожу за продуктами, недалеко от дома. (The store I go to for groceries is near home.)
items.promptEnglish: The store I shop at is close to home.
items.hint: Ходить В + accusative (direction: I go TO the store).
items.explanation: Direction (going TO the store) uses accusative: в который.

items.prompt: Ребёнок, _____ играет во дворе, мой сосед. (The child playing in the yard is my neighbor.)
items.promptEnglish: The child playing in the yard is my neighbor.
items.hint: The child IS playing = subject of the clause = nominative.
items.explanation: Который is the subject of 'plays,' so it stays nominative: который.

items.prompt: Учительница, _____ мы благодарны, уходит на пенсию. (The teacher we're grateful to is retiring.)
items.promptEnglish: The teacher we're grateful to is retiring.
items.explanation: Благодарны + dative: которой (feminine dative of который).

items.prompt: Стол, _____ стоят цветы, купили на распродаже. (The table on which flowers stand was bought at a sale.)
items.promptEnglish: The table the flowers are on was bought at a sale.
items.hint: Стоять НА чём? Prepositional (location on surface).
items.explanation: Location on a surface: на + prepositional: на котором.

items.prompt: Вопрос, _____ никто не мог ответить, был очень сложным. (The question nobody could answer was very difficult.)
items.promptEnglish: The question nobody could answer was very difficult.
items.hint: Ответить НА что? Accusative with на.
items.explanation: Ответить на + accusative: на который (masculine inanimate, accusative = nominative).

items.prompt: Художник, _____ картинами украшен весь зал, знаменит. (The artist whose paintings decorate the hall is famous.)
items.promptEnglish: The artist whose paintings decorate the whole hall is famous.
items.hint: Whose paintings = possessive. Чей declines like a possessive.
items.explanation: Possessive relative: чьими (instrumental plural, agreeing with картинами). Чей/чья/чьё/чьи also forms relative clauses.

patternRecognition.sentence: в котором / на котором / о котором / при котором
patternRecognition.question: What case is который in all of these?
patternRecognition.explanation: All use prepositions that take prepositional case for location: в, на, о, при + prepositional.

patternRecognition.sentence: с которым / за которым / перед которым / над которым
patternRecognition.question: What case is который in all of these?
patternRecognition.explanation: These prepositions all take instrumental: с, за (behind), перед, над + instrumental.

blanks: Район, _____ мы переехали, очень тихий. (The neighborhood we moved to is very quiet.)
Это песня, _____ я никогда не забуду. (This is a song I will never forget.)
Друзья, _____ я учусь, помогают мне с русским. (The friends I study with help me with Russian.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Mixed cases and prepositions with который
hints: Забыть что? Accusative. Песня is feminine.
explanations: Direction: в который (moving TO the neighborhood).
Direct object: которую (feminine accusative of который).
Accompaniment: с которыми (plural instrumental of который).
